newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel Radio says two dead, many hurt in shooting.
newsitem.headline: Israel Radio says two dead, many hurt in shooting.

text.p: Israel Radio said two people were killed and many people were wounded when a gunman opened fire from Jordan on Thursday.
It said the shooting occurred in the Naharayim area of the Jordan Valley.
Israel Radio said it appeared a tourist bus or schoolbus was the target of the shooting.
A witness told Israeli army radio: "A group of schoolgirls...told us that a Jordanian soldier opened fire on them. They tried to flee from there because they wouldn't let them evacuate the wounded."
Israel and Jordan are partners to a 1994 peace treaty and their border has been traditionally quiet for many years.
